title: Claude Desktop app data
whyItMatters: Claude Desktop keeps a local configuration, logs and cached app state here. It shows the desktop app was used on this PC and which local tools it was allowed to start.
source: Model Context Protocol docs for Claude Desktop: config and logs under %APPDATA%/Claude - https://modelcontextprotocol.io/quickstart/user
notes: Config and logs used by Claude Desktop, including claude_desktop_config.json. The Microsoft Store/MSIX build may keep a copy under %LOCALAPPDATA%/Packages. Conversations are account-based; nothing is opened.

cleanup.signOut: Sign out of Claude Desktop on this PC so the account no longer keeps a signed-in session here.
steps: Uninstall Claude from Settings > Apps > Installed apps.
Delete the Claude folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes the local Claude configuration and logs from this PC. Conversations stored with the account stay there.
cleanup.source: Claude Help Center, Install Claude Desktop: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/10065433-install-claude-desktop
